name: Ferrata blind red-team vectors
written: 2026-11-18, phase 1 (blind): from the specification documents only; see README.md

schema.codes: for a refusal, every code the specification allows (the first is the one it points to most directly); namespaces core:, step:, prog:, cons:, bridge: are exit codes; lez:validity-window, lez:any, evm:revert, any are described in other_codes
schema.kind: adversarial (an attack or a malformed input) | control (a valid input that must be accepted)

baselines.B-LC-MAIN: Mainnet light-client fixture (Fulu, 512-member committees, periods 1899-1903 or the newer mainnet fixture): an instance of the attestation program initialised from its checkpoint, committees adopted; the next real finality update U and its signer witness. LEZ v0.4 in-process harness.
baselines.B-LC-SEP: Sepolia fixture: an instance initialised from the period-1378 bootstrap with Sepolia's schedule (Gloas at epoch 353,024); real Fulu- and Gloas-era updates.
baselines.B-LC-SYN: A synthetic chain: a committee whose secret keys the test holds (minimal or mainnet preset), a checkpoint and states built by the test, so the test can sign any header with any subset.
baselines.B-AT-MAIN: The record of a finalized mainnet block (payload layout) written by the program, with eth_getProof account and storage proofs and receipt proofs of that block.
baselines.B-AT-GLOAS: A Sepolia record in the Gloas layout (execution block hash only), the block's RLP header and proofs.
baselines.B-AT-ACC: A record whose state holds the vault's deposit-root slot (FerrataVault v5 on Sepolia, or a synthetic state) and real leaves with their 32-sibling paths.
baselines.B-CON: The reference consumer's Pool (ERC-20 Transfer to a recipient) bound to B-AT-MAIN's instance.
baselines.B-CON-VAULT: The reference consumer's VaultPool over FerrataVault v5's deposits (rules 5-7), with depositors' secrets.
baselines.B-BR: The bridge program with the attestation program: configuration A paired with vault V, token T registered with denominations d0<d1<d2, root(A, n) imported, deposits whose (s, kind, dest) the test knows.
baselines.B-VLT: FerrataVault v5 under forge (vault/test), mock or real verifier as in its suite.
baselines.B-CKP: The checkpoint core (checkpoint/crates) with its v0.4-format fixture blocks and test sequencer keys.
baselines.B-BC: ferrata-bridge-core's commitment, nullifier and burn-note functions.

other_codes.lez:validity-window: LEZ refuses the transaction (timestamp validity window); no exit code
other_codes.lez:any: LEZ refuses the transaction itself (signature, authorisation); no program exit code
other_codes.any: refused with any error (the specification names no code)
